comments.note: The four-branch template pattern (target_vscode / target_claude_code / target_deep_agents / else) is used here, which is more complete than the two-branch pattern (target_vscode / else) used by existing standalone personas like plan-refiner.md. If the project standardizes on a single pattern, this could be a refactoring opportunity.

summary: PASS — All 6 ACs from WP-010.md scope verified. developer.yaml correctly updated with 'agent' in tools and 'subagents: [standalone-archiver]', changelog bumped to v1.2.0. The 'Archive to Ledger (Optional)' step is placed correctly in developer.md (after synthesis writing, before Finish) with all three target-conditional variants (VS Code runSubagent, Claude Code Task, Deep Agents task) and an explicit non-blocking failure note. All three generated output files confirmed to contain the step. The four-branch dispatch pattern is intentional and AC-required. Two non-blocking observations carried forward: (1) artifact path inaccuracy in implementation record (developer-standalone.md vs developer.md for deep-agents target); (2) pre-existing frontmatter version derivation inconsistency unrelated to this change.

comments.note: The four-branch template (target_vscode / target_claude_code / target_deep_agents / else) is more complete than the two-branch pattern used by some other standalone personas. This is intentional and AC-required — no concern. The else fallback ensures any future unknown target renders a graceful human-readable instruction. The pattern is sound.

Minor audit-trail inaccuracy: the implementation pipeline artifacts record 'personas/standalone/deep-agents/developer-standalone.md' but the actual file is 'personas/standalone/deep-agents/developer.md' (deep-agents does not use the da_file_name suffix pattern). The correct file is confirmed to contain the dispatch step — no functional impact.

Pre-existing: vs-code frontmatter shows 'Developer (Standalone) v1.0.0' and 'version: 1.0.0' despite developer.yaml changelog being at v1.2.0. This version derivation inconsistency predates this WP and affects other standalone personas too. Not a regression from this change.

[documentation-forward] The version derivation discrepancy (changelog at v1.2.0 but frontmatter at v1.0.0) should be documented in the personas manifest constraints or in a known-limitations section. If the frontmatter version intentionally uses the initial release version rather than the latest changelog entry, this should be explicit. If it is a build system bug, it should be tracked as a known limitation.

summary: Addressed the documentation-forward item from code review (frontmatter version derivation inconsistency). Added a 'Known limitation' callout to constraint B10/C37 in personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints-build-system.md, explaining that the library's changelog-based version derivation for frontmatter generation requires @mistralys/persona-builder >= 2.5.0. With v2.4.x (currently installed at 2.4.1), the frontmatter version: falls back to default_version regardless of changelog: content, causing a discrepancy vs. name-mapping.json and agent_* variables. Confirmed root cause by inspecting the installed library dist (no resolveChangelogMeta present). The note includes the actionable fix (update to >= 2.5.0) and explicitly warns against adding a version: YAML field as a workaround.

comments.note: Addressed documentation-forward from code review: added a 'Known limitation' blockquote to constraint B10/C37 in constraints-build-system.md. The note explains that the library's changelog-based frontmatter version derivation requires @mistralys/persona-builder >= 2.5.0. With 2.4.x installed, the library falls back to default_version regardless of changelog: content, causing a visible discrepancy vs. name-mapping.json. Confirmed by inspecting the installed 2.4.1 dist (no resolveChangelogMeta in built output). Actionable fix and explicit anti-pattern (do not add version: to YAML) are included.

No changes were needed to the standalone developer persona source files (developer.yaml, developer.md) or generated output — those were correctly implemented and verified by earlier pipeline stages. Documentation scope for this WP is the constraints-build-system.md known-limitation note only.
